mapper.insert: INSERT INTO optimization_session(id, tenant_id, workspace_id, created_by, title) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenant}, #{workspace}, #{user}, '合成设置验收历史')
mapper.select: SELECT a.status, a.deleted_at AS deleted, a.security_version AS version, a.locale, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_identity i WHERE i.user_id=a.id AND i.status='ACTIVE') AS identities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM optimization_session s WHERE s.created_by=a.id) AS histories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workspace_member m WHERE m.user_id=a.id) AS memberships FROM user_account a WHERE a.id=#{user}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_identity SET status='REVOKED' WHERE user_id=#{user}
UPDATE email_binding_challenge SET expires_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 second' WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT status, attempts, consumed_at AS consumed FROM email_binding_challenge WHERE id=#{id}
